deterministic.reason: All behavior surfaces required by AGENTS.md were added.
Prettier passed for all changed code files.
Affected packages reported no errors and only pre-existing warnings.
Removing factory installation makes the new test fail because Stripe-Signature is absent; restoration returns green.
Removing seedFromConfig factory installation makes the standalone seed test fail for the intended reason; restoration returns green.
The map found 14 changed and 15 impacted symbols with 4509 edges, but 18683 unresolved calls mean it under-covers; full subsystem inspection and the complete suite were used.

findings.claim: A throwing header factory could bypass delivery logging.
findings.evidence: The factory initially ran before the protected delivery block. It was moved inside the try and a forced failure now records duration 0 and success false.

findings.claim: Standalone Stripe seed configuration depended on plugin registration order.
findings.evidence: Without configuring the factory in seedFromConfig, the standalone test received no Stripe-Signature. The seed path now installs the shared Stripe factory.

findings.claim: Required behavior documentation surfaces were missing.
findings.evidence: AGENTS.md requires root README, service skill, docs site, and CLI help updates for behavior changes; all required surfaces are now present, plus the package README.

exemptions.claim: No Stripe SDK dev dependency is required.
exemptions.evidence: The regression test independently recomputes the official HMAC contract with node:crypto.

exemptions.claim: Slack and Resend are outside this PR.
exemptions.evidence: Neither service exposes a consumer-reachable production subscription surface.
Linear uses an independent dispatcher and a different delivery-log shape.

issue_candidates.title: Expose webhook subscription surfaces for Slack and Resend
issue_candidates.evidence: Both packages dispatch events, but production consumers cannot create subscriptions.
